This pre-release adds a single, fully static binary for older ARMv7 Linux devices, built from the Holesail flake. It also updates HyperDHT to `3e022ea`, including the recent connection and relay fixes.

ARMv7 requires the hard-float ABI and VFPv3-D16; NEON is not required. It has been checked under emulation, but physical ARMv7 testing is still pending. The original Raspberry Pi Zero (ARMv6) is not supported.

Download the binary for your architecture, make it executable, and run it. No Nix installation or shared libraries are needed for the Linux static builds.
